what: An example belief written by the HardRead authors, not a real player's read. It ran on the assumed sets the showcase review used. A saved result, not a live check.

selection.decision: The offered decision with the largest gap: the one the page calls 'the one decision to look at again'.
selection.pokemon: The opposing Pokemon active at that decision (ctx.opp_active).
selection.belief: The most used detail in the engine's set data that the log had not revealed by then. Its item, ability and Tera have one value each, and Ivy Cudgel was revealed, so: Swords Dance.
selection.kept: Both were fixed before the search ran, and this is the only run of this belief.
